descriptions.notStarted: I heard that Blackbull is fixing his house...
descriptions.inProgress: Right here, in this dusty town of Perion, I ran into an oddly-dressed man named Blackbull. He told me he needs to fix is house and wondered if I could help him out by getting him #b30 tree branches and 50 firewoods#k. If I do him a favor, I get myself a nice shield that he has, but what if I say no? I wouldn't ... be ... EATEN BY HIM ... no?? I really hope not...
descriptions.completed: I got Blackbull of Perion #b30 tree branches and 50 firewoods#k. With these, he can finally fix his house. I got this shield as a reward ... and ... well, scratchmarks here and there, and it looks pretty old ... is this even usable?
